Maya (Marketing): quick ask 10min sync: we need a compact battlecard that leads with migration risk reduction + predictable inference economics. keep it SDR-friendly.
Noor (Product Marketing): agreed. angle: 'migration-proof inference'  highlight fallbacks, reserved capacity, and cost transparency.
Sam (Sales): reps want: 1) 1-line opener 2) 30s discovery + 1 pricing rebuttal. short.
Priya (Research): bench headline we can use: 'avg token cost down 30% in embedding pipelines; p95 latency stable under burst.' will provide 1-line methods.
Owen (Field): add ops bullet: KMS + audit logs + exportable traces for exit. procurement loves the escape hatch.
Maya (Marketing): deliverables: 1-page PDF + 2-slide migration play + 3 subject lines for A/B. owners?
Sam (Sales): I'll draft sales lines + two competitor knockouts by EOD.
Noor (Product Marketing): I'll craft the migration play slides; short copy only.
Priya (Research): sending the tiny methods blurb in-thread in ~60m; will include key knob settings (prefix cache, quant).
launch-bot: Webinar provisional hold: 2024-10-02 15:00 UTC  invite pending.
Maya (Marketing): sample 1-liner: "Redwood Inference: migration-proof LLM serving  predictable costs, safe rollouts, and enterprise controls."
Sam (Sales): quick SDR discovery (30s): "When you roll models, do you see surprise bills or latency spikes? We lock unit economics and give rollback paths so migrations don't become crises."
Noor (Product Marketing): subject lines to test:
A) "Migrate LLMs without surprising bills"
B) "Keep inference latency predictable during rollouts"
C) "Migration playbook: fallbacks, SLAs, and cost control"
Maya (Marketing): timeline: lock assets by next Tue. Sam/Noor/Priya/Owen = owners. I'll assemble final PDF and landing copy. Pinning draft folder: https://drive.redwood.example/marketing/migration-playbooks :pushpin:
